verdict.summary: Round 2 remains correct and complete. Rule C2 is conservative: it applies only to bound-predicate patterns sharing the same subject variable, requires the same source to be a candidate for both, verifies per-predicate characteristic-set accounting with checked addition, rejects duplicate normalized set keys, and retains assignments on incomplete or unalignable evidence. Descriptor identity and pattern-permutation checks prevent summaries from being applied to the wrong source or BGP pattern. Candidate collapse is conservative, and combination_is_dead preserves cross-source assignments. The tests are non-vacuous and exercise the live pruning path plus truncation, unknown accounting, duplicate keys, overflow, malformed selections, source mismatch, non-subject joins, unbound predicates, and cross-source survival. Documentation keeps the feature opt-in and explicitly avoids cryptographic privacy or soundness claims. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was found in the diff. With no prior-round findings and no current findings, progress is stagnant under the required comparison scale.
